opportunity.title: GSA.gov Public-Facing Website Modernization and Accessibility Uplift
opportunity.description: The General Services Administration (GSA) seeks a qualified small business to modernize its public-facing informational website. The work includes migrating content from legacy CMS to a modern Next.js-based headless CMS, implementing WCAG 2.1 AA / Section 508 compliance across all pages, improving Core Web Vitals scores, and deploying to cloud infrastructure. The contractor shall deliver a fully accessible, mobile-responsive website with automated accessibility testing integrated into the CI/CD pipeline. Period of performance: 6 months. Deliverables include: discovery report, design system, production deployment, and final accessibility audit report. No prior federal past performance required at this award level.

profile.name: Frasier Digital LLC
profile.capabilities: Government web modernization, Section 508 accessibility compliance, AI/RAG chatbot development, cloud migration (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government), IT consulting, digital transformation for federal agencies.
